title: Salome
description: A dancing princess (Rita Hayworth) loves a Roman commander (Stewart Granger) and inspires King Herod (Charles Laughton) to have John the Baptist beheaded.

title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: Love Has Many Faces
description: A woman (Lana Turner) lives in Acapulco with moochers and a husband (Cliff Robertson) who married her for her money.

title: There's Something About a Soldier
description: Five young men train to become military officers.

title: The Running Man
description: An insurance man (Alan Bates) gets chummy in Spain with a couple (Laurence Harvey, Lee Remick) who have collected on a fake death.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: The Notorious Landlady
description: A U.S. diplomat (Jack Lemmon) tries to help his London landlady (Kim Novak) in a mix-up over jewels and her husband's murder.

title: Don't Knock the Twist
description: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: American Madness
description: An idealistic bank officer is taken to task by the board of directors when they learn of his unorthodox loan policies.

title: Twentieth Century
description: An actress (Carole Lombard) deserts the Broadway director (John Barrymore) who bolstered her career, then meets him on the Chicago-New York express.

title: The Silencers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Three Stooges in Orbit
description: Three men get mixed up with some Martian spies' invention.

title: Murderers' Row
description: A secret agent blocks a villain's helio-beam plot in the second of four Matt Helm movies.

title: You Belong to Me
description: A doctor's (Barbara Stanwyck) idle millionaire husband (Henry Fonda) becomes unbearably jealous of her patients.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
description: A dreamer (Jerry Lewis) and a British con man (Terry-Thomas) plot to steal an oil-drill invention and sell it to the Arabs.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: Born Yesterday
description: A scrap-metal tycoon (Broderick Crawford) pays a Washington newsman (William Holden) to make his girlfriend (Judy Holliday) couth.

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: Tight Spot
description: A detective (Brian Keith) guards a brassy blonde (Ginger Rogers) freed from prison to be a federal prosecutor's (Edward G. Robinson) key mob witness.

title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: The Fuller Brush Girl
description: A door-to-door saleswoman (Lucille Ball) and her boyfriend (Eddie Albert) flee from mobsters and the police after a murder mix-up.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: What a Woman!
description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Born Free
description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

title: Human Desire
description: An Oklahoma train engineer's (Glenn Ford) lover (Gloria Grahame) wants him to kill her husband (Broderick Crawford).

title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
description: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: Let's Do It Again
description: A composer's (Ray Milland) singing-and-dancing wife (Jane Wyman) tries to make him jealous, but it backfires into a divorce.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A World War II hero (Humphrey Bogart) solves his buddy's murder, starting with a singer (Lizabeth Scott) and a nightclub owner (Morris Carnovsky).
